info.name: Unity Analytics Allocations Leaderboards API
info.description:
The Unity Analytics REST API provides endpoints for ingesting custom analytics events from game clients and servers. Events are used to track player behavior, game performance, and feature adoption. The API supports batched event ingestion with automatic retry and buffering for high-volume game telemetry.

Contact Support:
